codeLivewirePhp:
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Component;

class DirtyModalGuard extends Component
{
    #[Locked] public array $record = ['name' => 'NH-WS-014', 'branch' => 'North Hub'];

    public function saveRecord(string $name, string $branch): array
    {
        $this->record = Validator::make(['name' => trim($name), 'branch' => $branch], [
            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:80'],
            'branch' => ['required', Rule::in(['North Hub', 'Harbor Office', 'Central Campus'])],
        ])->validate();
        return $this->record;
    }

    public function render(): View
    {
        return view('livewire.dirty-modal-guard');
    }
}
